name: Duplicate adjacent If/ElseIf body
description: Flags consecutive If/ElseIf branches whose bodies are the same, since that usually means a condition was copied and the body was left unchanged.
definition: Flags, as an `[info]`, two adjacent arms of the same `If`/`ElseIf` chain whose bodies are structurally identical (statement and expression shape, identifiers compared case-insensitively). Only neighboring arms are compared; a later arm that repeats an earlier body with a different body in between is left alone. Empty bodies are left to `empty-body`. An `Else` that repeats the last arm is not flagged, since that is often a deliberate fallback. Line numbers, columns, and whitespace alone do not trigger. This rule is enabled by the strict preset and disabled by the standard and careful presets.
